text:
maya (PM): Quick thread: rough proposal for a "launch-surge-lane" to triage week 0 post-launch. Want clear gating so engineers know what to fix now vs schedule later. Thoughts?

liam (ENG): good idea. prefer short twice-daily triage slots (10:30 & 16:00) to keep momentum without chaos.

tara (Support): from support: we need a lightweight customer-impact rubric so we can tag tickets consistently. current backlog tags are noisy.

jia (Data): agree — add quantitative triggers we can pull into dashboards: crash_count > 3 per customer/hour, new error signature > 0.5% of requests, or feature-usage drop > 20% vs baseline.

ren (ProdOps): proposed severity mapping:
- S0: critical platform outage or data corruption -> hotpatch in hours, page all hands
- S1: major user flow broken for paying customers -> target 48h fix or scheduled hotfix in next deploy window
- S2: functional degradation or confusion with workaround -> include in next weekly fix batch
- S3: enhancements, polish, or requests -> roadmap/icebox

alex (Design): UX note: call out "core-path" vs "secondary-path". Core-path regressions (signup, auth, core API) escalate to S1 automatically. Add "screenshot + minimal repro" requirement for UI tickets.

liam (ENG): dev process additions:
- Create issue with label: launch-surge:S0|S1|S2|S3 and "customer:ID" if relevant
- Attach repro or sample trace, add unit if possible
- If S0/S1, tag "fastlane-review" for 2 reviewers and one oncall approval

maya (PM): ownership: ren will manage lane and triage calendar for first 7 days. we'll re-evaluate cadence at day 8.

tara (Support): automated routing idea: have support-bot create a draft issue when 2 distinct customers open a ticket with same error keyword within 6h. ren, can you wire that?

ren (ProdOps): yes. plan to wire support-bot + ops-bot so issues get pre-labeled. draft rule: keywords match OR identical stack traces -> create issue draft in "launch-surge" board.

jia (Data): I'll publish a small dashboard card with those three metrics and a green/yellow/red for triage.

liam (ENG): release constraints: hotfix windows defined:
- S0: emergency patch any time (oncall rotates)
- S1: next hotfix window (max 24h) or canary release if infra allows
- S2: batch weekly release
Also: canary policy: 5% traffic for 20min, monitor error/latency/QA smoke.

alex (Design): if a UI regression is S1, we should ship a tiny CSS fix immediately if it restores flow. avoid heavyweight redesigns during surge.

maya (PM): decision criteria for moving ticket to enhancement (S3): documented workaround exists, affects <0.8% DAU, no data integrity risk, and no contractual SLA impact. Otherwise keep S1/S2.

tara (Support): can we add a short template for support to include in tickets? like:
"""
Steps to reproduce:
Customer impact (customers affected):
Node / region / app version if known:
Screenshots / logs:
"""
That would speed triage.

liam (ENG): +1. also add code snippet for quick labeling automation (pseudo):
```
# quick create and label
support-bot create-issue --title "Auto: <short>" --body @support-template && support-bot tag --add launch-surge:S1
```
ops-bot: Created rule LS-22: auto-create launch-surge drafts for matching support keywords. Linked to oncall rotation.

maya (PM): action list:
- ren: create "launch-surge" board + calendar slots (today)
- liam: document fastlane reviewer checklist + merge window details (tomorrow AM)
- jia: attach dashboard card to triage board (EOD)
- tara: start using ticket template immediately and flag any pain points
- alex: prepare a tiny UI fix checklist for S1 (EOD)

ren (ProdOps): will run first triage at 10:30. adding rota: ren, liam, maya, tara (rotate).

maya (PM): ok if no objections I’ll pin this thread and do a 12-min walkthrough during daily at 12:05. we want signals and owners aligned before surge.

jia (Data): will send a quick alert feed to #product-ops so triage knows when thresholds hit.

liam (ENG): small ask: add acceptance for rollback decision — if error rate increases >50% after deploy, roll back immediately and tag root cause.

maya (PM): noted. I'll add rollback threshold.

alex (Design): :thumbsup:

tara (Support): :thumbsup: will start using template now.

liam (ENG): :+1:
